system.description:
15th Level Clan Feature

You have dominion over your own reality. Your own domain. Your own world. You have gone beyond what other Yoton’s have found to be the peak. You have gone beyond that. You have found your zenith.

As an Action, you create a massive aura of raw magma chakra that radiates out from you in a 40-foot radius for the next minute, centered on you as you become a Forge of change. For the duration, this aura has the following benefits;

All terrain within this radius becomes Molten Terrain.

You can apply up to 4 Foundations at once to your Molten Terrain.

At the beginning of each creature with the Molten conditions turn, you gain 10 Temporary hit points.
